effects.name: pins
effects.summary: The text becomes pin art: a field of metal pins around the words with the letters pushed out in relief.
effects.looks: A field of thin metal pins seen through the page camera gathers around the words, their domed tips catching a studio light. The field follows the shape of the text and thins out at its edge, the last pins smaller and sunk into the page, so no plate or box shows. The pins inside the letters stand out toward the viewer, so the text rises as a crisp relief over the low pins, which sit dimmer and fainter in its shade; the raised pins cast soft shadows on the field and the page, and their shafts show at the edges in perspective. Pins are spaced in ems, so a letter is the same number of pins wide at any font size. As the heading comes into view the letters rise out of the flat field in a wave from left to right, overshooting a little, while the flat pins bob as the wave passes. The pointer presses the pins in under a soft circle, or pushes them out with press out, and they spring back with a wobble when it moves on. The bars style turns the pins into square bars, like a city skyline, and the domes style into round buttons, like a tactile display.
effects.target: a heading or a short label in a bold or display font, 48 px and larger. Not img, video, canvas, svg or form fields

params.description: pins are thin metal pins; bars are square bars; domes are round plastic buttons.

params.name: press

params.description: Distance between the centers of neighboring pins in ems; it widens on long text to keep the pin count.

params.name: height
params.description: How far the letters stand out of the field; 0 leaves the field flat.

params.name: radius
params.description: Reach of the soft circle the pointer presses; 0 turns the pointer off.

params.name: color
params.description: Color of the pins, any CSS color; currentColor takes the text color.

params.name: duration
params.description: Time from the first pin rising to the last, the wave across the field included.

params.name: seed
params.description: Picks the small differences between pins and their timing.

reducedMotion.note: The letters stand in relief from the start and stay still: no rising wave, no pressing, and no frames of their own.

presence.note: Leaving a page the pins sink back into the field and fade; entering, they rise again.

effects.name: melt
effects.summary: Letters melt like wet paint, candle wax or liquid metal, running down in glossy drips that stretch, neck and let their drops fall.
effects.looks: The shape of each letter turns liquid: its corners round off, its top sinks a little and its foot spreads, while drips run from the undersides of the strokes, widen into a bulb and now and then let a drop go that falls away below the text. The liquid is lit as a 3D surface with a round edge: sharp highlights along the rims, reflections of a small photo studio that slide as the page scrolls, and a soft shadow on the page. Drip is glossy paint in the color of the text, wax is warm and translucent with a pool along the baseline, and chrome is liquid mercury that ripples. The heading melts under the pointer and sets again when it leaves, follows the scroll, melts once as it comes into view and stays that way, or drips on a slow loop.

effects.name: unfold
effects.summary: A headline unfolds out of the page like paper: strips, a zig-zag band, letter cards or folded squares open in 3D.
effects.looks: The text block is cut into pieces of paper hinged to each other. Before it opens you see the folded packet: off-white paper backs with a faint fiber, the letters showing through a little. As it comes into view the pieces swing open one after another in perspective, standing out of the page on the way: the side turned to the light brightens, folds darken toward the crease, and the raised paper casts a soft shadow on the page. Strips roll down line by line like a letter out of an envelope, an accordion stretches open sideways, each letter of cards stands up like a little card on its bottom edge, and origami opens squares folded corner to center. Once everything lies flat the heading is plain text again.

effects.name: blinds
effects.summary: A heading printed across real 3D slats that turn over in a wave, lit and casting shadows, to show it.
effects.looks: The heading starts behind a closed panel of slats in a solid color, like a shutter or a flip sign. The slats turn over one after another, each a thin board in perspective whose painted back and edges catch the light, casting thin shadows on its neighbors and on the page, until the text lies flat and readable. Horizontal slats turn like venetian blinds, vertical ones like a shop shutter, and square tiles flip in a diagonal ripple like a stadium card display. The pointer nudges the slats near it, and the nudge runs on through the others before they settle. A second text can be printed on the backs, so the turn switches between two messages.
effects.target: a heading or short text in a large font, on a solid page background. Not img, video, canvas, svg or form fields

params.name: style
params.description: horizontal turns strips like blinds; vertical turns upright slats; tiles flips cards.

params.name: trigger
params.description: view opens it once in view; scroll opens with the scroll; hover opens near the pointer.

params.name: slats
params.description: Slats per line of text, top to bottom; vertical slats and tiles get a like size.

params.name: gap
params.description: Space between neighboring slats while they turn; 0 closes them edge to edge.

params.name: duration
params.description: Time one slat takes to turn over.

params.name: stagger
params.description: Time between one slat starting to turn and the next, shortened on long waves.

params.name: delay
params.description: Wait before the first slat turns, with trigger view.

params.name: threshold
params.description: Share of the heading in view before it opens, with trigger view or scroll.

params.name: angle
params.description: Turn of the slats at rest with trigger hover: 180 closed on their back, 90 edge-on, 0 open.

params.name: light
params.description: Where the light comes from as a CSS angle, 0 above and 90 right.

params.name: back
params.description: Color of the slats' backs and edges; currentColor uses the text color.

params.name: reverse
params.description: Text printed on the backs, a second message on the closed panel; empty leaves them plain.

frames.note: Only while slats turn or settle after the pointer: with trigger view while the wave runs, with scroll while scrolling, with hover while slats follow the pointer; none at rest.

reducedMotion.note: Off: the text is shown as it is, and the engine does not load for it.

presence.note: Leaving a page the slats close again in reverse and fade; entering one, they open as the page comes in.

effects.touch: View and scroll work the same; a moving finger nudges the slats. With trigger hover a tap opens every slat in a ripple from the finger, and the next tap closes them.

notes.low: The text is rastered at 1 device pixel per CSS pixel instead of 2.

cost.gpu: One instanced draw of a box per slat, up to 2048, and a shadow quad over the panel that tests up to nine slats per pixel; nothing at rest.
cost.memory: The text raster at twice its CSS size, the second text if any, and a small table of slat angles.

effects.name: keycaps
effects.summary: Each letter sits on a 3D mechanical keycap that presses down as if the word were typed, with a click under the pointer.
effects.looks: The heading becomes a row of real 3D keycaps on a darker keyboard case, seen at an angle in the page perspective. Each cap is rounded, slightly dished and tapered, lit like plastic with a soft sheen, and the letter is printed on its top in the text color; a space becomes a wide space bar. When the heading comes into view the keys go down one after another as if someone typed the word: a quick press, a small bounce back and a flash of light on each. Keys under the pointer sink a little and a click sends one down hard. Modern sculpted caps with an accent key, beige retro caps, or dark caps with an RGB glow under them.
effects.target: a short heading, a word mark or a button label. Not img, video, canvas, svg or form fields

params.name: trigger

params.name: radius

params.name: speed
params.description: Typing speed in keys per second.

params.name: sound
params.description: Plays a short synthesized click per key press, only after the visitor touched the page.

frames.note: Only while keys move or flash; none at rest, when the keyboard stays drawn.

reducedMotion.note: The keys are drawn but never press, flash or type.

presence.note: Fades with the page.

notes.low: The legends are rastered at 1 device pixel per CSS pixel instead of 2.

effects.name: lens
effects.summary: A glass reading lens follows the pointer over the text, magnifying it through real curved glass.
effects.looks: A thick biconvex lens in a thin steel ring hovers over the page under the pointer. Every pixel is traced through both curved faces of the glass: the text comes up sharp and magnified in the middle, bends and splits into colors toward the rim, and the glass reflects a softbox and a dim studio, strongest at its edge. On the page beside it lies its shadow with the bright spot of light it focuses, and the shadow of its handle. The lens leans into its motion and settles with a little sway.
effects.target: a block of text: an article, a column of fine print, a spec sheet or a caption; the lens shows its text over its solid background. Not img, video, canvas, svg or form fields

params.name: radius
params.description: Radius of the lens on screen in px.

params.name: zoom
params.description: Magnification in the middle of the lens; 1 is plain glass.

params.name: dispersion
params.description: How far the glass splits colors toward the rim; 0 has no color fringes.

params.name: thickness
params.description: How domed the glass is; thicker bends the rim more and hovers lower.

params.name: tilt
params.description: Largest lean into the motion in degrees; 0 keeps the lens level.

params.name: ease
params.description: Seconds the lens lags behind the pointer; 0 follows it exactly.

frames.note: None at rest and none while the lens is hidden. Full rate while it moves, leans, settles or fades in and out.

reducedMotion.note: The lens jumps with the pointer: no lag, no lean.

presence.note: The lens fades with the page.

effects.touch: The lens appears while a finger is pressed on the text, held a little above the finger so it stays visible, and leaves when the finger lifts or the page scrolls.

notes.low: The text is rastered at the screen resolution instead of up to four times it.

cost.gpu: One quad around the lens and its shadow while it shows; three rays through the glass per pixel, one per color.
cost.memory: A canvas of the text at up to four device pixels per CSS px with mip levels, at most about six million pixels.

effects.name: water
effects.summary: A headline under water: the surface bends the letters, focuses dancing caustics on them and ripples under the pointer.
effects.looks: The text lies a few centimeters under a real water surface. On the page the water is a puddle around the words with a wandering, rounded shore, shallow and nearly clear at its edge and deeper toward the letters, where its surface curls down to the page in a thin bright line; on an element with its own background it fills that box like a pool with walls. A height field simulated on the GPU, plus a slow swell, gives every point of the surface a normal: the letters are seen bent through it, the light it focuses draws a net of caustics over the letters and the floor, and the surface reflects a sky with a window and the glints of the sun by Fresnel. The water tints what lies deeper, red first. Moving the pointer drags a wake, a click drops a stone that rings out, rain lands in rings on its own, and ice is clear with frost and cracks, thinner over the letters so their color reads, until the pointer melts a clear patch that freezes over again.
effects.target: a heading or short text in a large font, on a solid page color or with its own solid background, with padding of about a third of an em for the puddle. Not img, video, canvas, svg or form fields

params.name: style
params.description: pool is clear water with a moving swell; rain rings out under falling drops; ice is clear, frosted and cracked.

params.name: trigger
params.description: loop keeps the water moving; hover keeps it still until the pointer comes over it.

params.name: depth
params.description: How strongly the surface bends the letters seen through it; 0 keeps them straight.

params.name: caustics
params.description: Brightness of the light the waves focus on the letters and the floor; 0 turns it off.

params.name: ripples
params.description: Strength of the wake and the drops the pointer makes; 0 leaves the water alone.

params.name: rain
params.description: Raindrops a second with the rain style; 0 stops the rain.

params.name: damping
params.description: How fast ripples die out; 0 lets them run and bounce for a long time.

params.name: tint
params.description: Depth of the water color over the letters and the page; 0 is perfectly clear.

frames.note: With trigger loop, 30 frames a second while on screen (ice: only while a melted patch refreezes or ripples run). With hover, 30 a second while the pointer is over and the ripples settle, none at rest: the still water stays drawn.

reducedMotion.note: The water stays still: the swell holds its shape, there are no ripples, rain or melting, and the still water stays drawn.

presence.note: The water fades with the page.

effects.touch: There is no wake without a mouse. A tap drops a ripple and, with hover, wakes the swell or the rain for a moment; on ice it melts a patch.

notes.low: The text is rastered at 1 device pixel per CSS pixel instead of 2 and the simulation grid is coarser.
notes.medium: The simulation grid is a little coarser.

cost.gpu: Two small half-float render targets of a few hundred cells a side, stepped about 60 times a second with nine reads per cell while waves run. The surface reads the simulation nine times and the letters once per pixel, plus the ice map on ice.
cost.memory: A canvas of the text at twice its CSS size with mip levels, two small simulation targets, a small half-float map of the shore of the puddle built once on the CPU and, for ice, a map of frost and cracks at about the size of the box.

effects.name: fire
effects.summary: The letters burn: flames rise from their tops, sparks drift up in depth and the firelight flickers on the page.
effects.looks: Flames rise from the tops of the strokes that face open air, in a plume built from the shape of the letters: white-yellow where they leave the strokes, orange higher up, red at the tips, swaying and torn into tongues by turbulence carried up through them, taller over one letter and lower over the next as the fire breathes. Over the strokes the flames thin out, so the text stays readable. The tops of the letters glow like embers, their faces warm toward the fire and darken with soot where it burned. A few sparks rise in front of and behind the letters and cool from yellow to red as they climb. The firelight flickers on the page around the text in step with the flames, and the letters cast a soft shadow below. The embers style turns the letters into hot coals with light in their cracks and low flames; the candle style puts one calm, swaying flame on top of each letter.
effects.target: a heading, a label or a short line of text, best on a dark background. Not img, video, canvas, svg or form fields

params.name: style
params.description: flame burns tall; embers makes glowing coals; candle lights one calm flame per letter.

params.name: trigger
params.description: loop burns on; hover lights near the pointer; view flares up once; scroll follows the page.

params.name: strength
params.description: Brightness of the flames, the sparks and the firelight; 0 puts the fire out.

params.name: height
params.description: Height of the flames over the letters, in ems; embers and candle keep theirs lower.

params.name: speed
params.description: Pace of the flames and the sparks; 0 holds the fire still.

params.name: embers
params.description: Sparks in the air at once; candle sends up a third as many, 0 for none.

params.name: color
params.description: Tint of the fire, any CSS color, such as a blue gas flame; empty for natural fire.

params.name: char
params.description: How dark the flames scorch the tops of the letters, recovering after; 0 for none.

params.name: seed
params.description: Picks the shape of the flames, the sparks and where the fire catches first.

frames.note: 30 a second while the fire burns and is on screen, none off screen. Hover and view draw nothing once the fire has died down and the char has faded, and view with embers stops once the coals settle; scroll draws while the text burns.

reducedMotion.note: A still warm glow: the letters lit and the page warm around them, no moving flames and no sparks. Candles stand still, coals keep their glow, and nothing is drawn after.

presence.note: Leaving a page the fire dies down and the letters fade with it; entering they catch fire again.

effects.touch: With trigger hover a tap lights the letters around it for a moment; focus on the element or its link lights them all.

notes.low: At most 10 sparks, flames with less turbulence, and the text rastered at 1 device pixel per CSS pixel.

cost.gpu: A quad over the letters, one over the air above them for the flames (seven texture reads a pixel), one for the firelight around the text (two reads), and one small quad per spark or candle. Pixels with nothing to add are discarded.
cost.memory: A canvas of the text, a distance field of it, the plume the flames rise in, a small texture of the firelight and one of the heat of each letter.

effects.name: physics
effects.summary: Playful gravity type: the letters of a heading become thick lit 3D tiles that fall, bounce, tumble and pile up, can be thrown with the pointer, and stand back up.
effects.looks: Each letter turns into a solid tile cut in the shape of its glyph, as thick as the depth says, with beveled edges and walls that catch the light. When the heading falls, the tiles drop to the bottom of their container, bounce, tip over and tumble about all three axes, seen through the page camera, and come to rest in a pile, lying on their faces or leaning on each other, each casting a soft shadow on the page and the floor. The drop style collapses the heading where it stands, scatter bursts the letters outward so they settle across the floor, and stack drops them in from above one by one into their places with a bounce. A loose letter can be grabbed, dragged and thrown. On demand the letters fly back up and the heading is plain text again.
effects.target: a large heading or a short line of display text, in a container with room below it. Not img, video, canvas, svg or form fields

params.name: trigger

params.name: gravity
params.description: Pull of gravity, 1 is about earth for the page; 0 lets the letters float.

params.name: bounce
params.description: How much of its speed a letter keeps when it hits the floor or another letter.

params.name: friction
params.description: Grip between letters and the floor; 0 lets them slide like ice.

params.name: depth
params.description: Thickness of a tile in em of its font size; 0 draws flat letters.

params.name: throw
params.description: Strength of a throw with the pointer; 0 turns grabbing and knocking off.

params.name: container
params.description: Selector of an ancestor whose box the letters fall in; empty keeps the heading’s own box.

frames.note: While letters fall, fly, hop or are dragged; none once the pile has settled or the heading stands upright.

reducedMotion.note: Off: the heading stays upright as plain text, and the engine does not load for it.

presence.note: Fades with the page.

effects.touch: A finger drags and throws a loose letter without scrolling the page; in the hover trigger a tap knocks a letter off.

notes.low: The letters are rastered at 1 device pixel per CSS pixel instead of 2 and the march through each tile takes 8 steps instead of 24.
notes.medium: The march through each tile takes 14 steps instead of 24.

cost.gpu: One instanced draw of a box per letter, marched to the glyph in up to 24 texture reads per pixel, and two instanced draws of shadows.
cost.memory: An atlas of the letters at twice their CSS size with room for the shadows, and a relief map of the same size.

effects.name: smoke
effects.summary: A heading condenses out of drifting volumetric smoke as it comes into view, or dissolves into it as it leaves.
effects.looks: Smoke drifts in from below, swirls and thickens into the shapes of the letters, and the letters sharpen out of it until the plain text takes over. Dissolving, the letters soften and break up while plumes curl off their tops and rise away. The smoke is a real volume with depth: it is lit from behind and above, so thin wisps glow at their edges and the thick parts fall into their own shadow, and its layers shift against each other as the page scrolls. Styles give grey-white smoke for dark pages, a soft pale fog for light ones, or ink blooming in water in the color of the text.
effects.target: a large heading or a short line of display text. Not img, video, canvas, svg or form fields. Text with text-shadow, a text stroke, background-clip: text or vertical writing stays as it is

params.name: style
params.description: smoke is grey-white smoke lit from behind, for dark pages; mist is a soft pale fog for light pages; ink blooms in the color of the text, like ink in water.

params.name: trigger
params.description: view condenses the heading when it comes into view, a first-screen heading included; scroll condenses it toward the middle of the viewport and dissolves it as it leaves; hover lets wisps curl off the letters under the pointer; loop keeps smoke rising off the letters.

params.name: density
params.description: Thickness of the smoke; 0 leaves only the letters softening and fading.

params.name: speed
params.description: Pace of the swirling and drifting; 0 freezes the smoke in place.

params.name: rise
params.description: How far the smoke drifts upward as it leaves the letters; 0 keeps it in place.

params.name: turbulence
params.description: Strength of the swirls; 0 lets the smoke drift without curling.

params.name: duration
params.description: Time the view trigger takes to condense, and a hover wisp takes to settle.

params.name: color
params.description: Any CSS color for the smoke; empty uses grey-white for smoke, a pale fog for mist or the text color for ink.

params.name: seed
params.description: Picks the pattern of the swirls; the same seed drifts the same way.

frames.note: While the view trigger condenses, while scrolling with the scroll trigger and while hover wisps settle; none at rest. The loop trigger draws 30 frames a second while it is on screen.

reducedMotion.note: Off: the text shows as it is, without smoke.

presence.note: Leaving a page, the heading dissolves up into smoke; entering, it condenses out of it.

effects.touch: The same as with a mouse; with the hover trigger a tap breathes a wisp off the letters.

notes.low: 8 steps through the volume without a light step, and the text rastered at 1 device pixel per CSS pixel.
notes.medium: 12 steps with one step toward the light.

cost.gpu: One quad over the text and the room its smoke needs, marching 16 steps through the volume per pixel at the high tier, each with up to eight texture reads; empty air costs three.
cost.memory: A canvas of the text at twice its CSS size, a coarse half-float field of the glyphs and a 32 by 32 by 32 noise cube shared by every heading: about 3 MB for a large heading.

effects.name: prism
effects.summary: Letters become crystal: their edges split a light into a crisp spectrum that slides around them as the light moves.
effects.looks: The text turns into bevelled glass in its own color, standing a little off the page. The face stays crisp ink; across each bevel the glass bends the view outward, and every color by its own amount, so the edge of the ink splits into a clean spectrum, as through a prism. Sharp highlights and thin lines of light caught inside the edges follow a lamp, and where a bevel faces away from it the light leaves in a thin saturated spectrum along the contour, with a fainter one landing on the page just past the letter. The rainbows gather near the lamp and slide around the curves as it moves: it follows the pointer, sweeps with the scroll, orbits slowly or passes once as the text comes into view.
effects.target: a large heading or short display line in a bold font, on a plain background. Not img, video, canvas, svg or form fields

params.name: trigger

params.name: dispersion
params.description: How far the colors pull apart; 0 keeps the light white, with no rainbow.

params.name: spread
params.description: How far past the letters the thrown spectrum lands; 0 turns it off.

params.name: strength
params.description: Brightness of the rainbows, the highlights and the sparkle.

params.name: bevel
params.description: Width of the bevel along every edge in ems; larger is rounder glass.

params.name: light
params.description: Where the light comes from at rest as a CSS angle, 0 above and 90 right.

params.name: follow
params.description: How far the light moves toward the pointer or with the scroll; 0 holds it.

params.name: fps
params.description: Frame rate of the loop; 0 holds the light still.

frames.note: None at rest: the glass and its spectra stay drawn. Full rate while the light settles after the pointer moves, one frame per scroll with trigger scroll, `fps` frames a second on a loop while in view, and a short sweep on view.

reducedMotion.note: The light stays at its angle and the spectra hold still.

presence.note: The glass and its light fade with the page.

effects.touch: A finger does not move the light, so a tap or a swipe never flickers it; the scroll and loop triggers work as on desktop.

notes.low: The glass is built at 1 px per CSS px instead of 2, the light is split into 5 colors instead of 7, and the loop runs at most 24 frames a second.

cost.gpu: One quad over the text and a margin around it; about 25 texture reads per pixel, three per color of the split light.
cost.memory: A half-float relief of the text built once on the CPU from a distance field, and a canvas of the text.

effects.name: hologram
effects.summary: A heading becomes a 3D hologram: projected from a glowing emitter, built of slices in depth, crossed by scan lines.
effects.looks: A small emitter disc lies below the text, tipped toward you, with a lit ring, a turning ring of dashes and a bright core; it lights the page around it and throws a faint cone of light up through the text. The letters float in front of the page as several translucent slices stacked in depth: the front one solid and bright, the ones behind showing only the edges, so the text has volume. Fine scan lines cross it, a brighter band sweeps up through it, rows shimmer sideways, the color splits into red and blue fringes at the edges, and now and then the projection stutters or a band tears sideways. It sways slowly a few degrees and tips toward a pointer near it, and the parallax between the slices shows the depth. The card style mounts the slices on a dark holographic trading card with a foil border and a glossy foil in front: tipping it with the pointer shifts the slices against each other and sweeps a rainbow sheen across, and it keeps its last pose. The ghost style drops the projector: a cool, pale apparition that fades in from noise, drifts back and forth in depth and trails echoes behind it.
effects.target: a heading, a label or a short line of text, best on a dark background. Not img, video, canvas, svg or form fields

params.name: color
params.description: Color of the projection and its light, any CSS color; empty uses cyan (ghost: ice blue).

params.name: layers
params.description: Slices stacked in depth; 1 draws a flat projection.

params.name: depth
params.description: Depth of the stack of slices, in ems of the font size.

params.name: scan
params.description: Strength of the scan lines, the sweep and the row shimmer; 0 for a clean projection.

params.name: flicker
params.description: How often the projection stutters, drops out or tears; 0 holds it steady.

params.name: sway
params.description: Largest slow turn of the hologram, degrees; 0 keeps it still.

params.name: tilt
params.description: Largest tip toward a pointer near it, degrees (card: 1.8 times); 0 ignores it.

frames.note: trigger view: full rate while it scans in (about 1.5 s), then none. hover: 30 a second while powered up, full rate while powering up or down, none at rest. loop: 30 a second while on screen, none off screen. Full rate while it tips toward the pointer.

reducedMotion.note: A still hologram at full power: no scan-in, no sweep, no shimmer, no flicker, no sway, no tip; it draws no frames of its own.

presence.note: The projection fades with the page.

effects.touch: No tip toward the pointer. With trigger hover a tap powers it up and down.

notes.low: The text is rastered at 1 device pixel per CSS pixel instead of 2.

cost.gpu: Four draws: the light on the page, the emitter, the cone and one instanced quad per slice with five texture reads per pixel.
cost.memory: A canvas of the text at twice its CSS size, with its mip levels for the glow.
